description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different benchmarks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, with increments of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks. For each benchmark, two bars are shown: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of approximately 55%, while MMAR achieves around 32%. In the Audio-Reasoner benchmark, MMAU reaches an accuracy of about 62%, and MMAR achieves approximately 38%. In the Qwen-2.5-Omni benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of around 65%, and MMAR achieves approximately 58%. Overall, MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR across all three benchmarks, with the largest performance gap observed in the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct benchmark.
